title: Place detail page with facility intelligence display
description: Build the Place detail page showing all place fields in a read-only layout with edit capability. Display is organized into the same 3 sections as the form: Location, Facility Details, Contact & Intelligence. Includes an 'Edit' button that opens the PlaceFormDialog from FE-001 pre-populated with current values. Includes a 'Recent loads at this facility' section that shows an empty placeholder until load-management is built (per X-003).
acceptanceCriteria: PlaceDetailPage fetches place by ID from URL params using Redux getById action
Page header shows place name with back button (via PageHeader from @mocho/ui) and Edit action button
Location section displays: name, full address (address, address2, city, state, zip), lat/lng with geoSource indicator (Auto/Manual badge)

Facility Details section displays: facilityType as human-readable label, dockType, operatingHours, receivingHours, boolean badges for appointmentRequired, lumperRequired, ppeRequired (colored chips: Yes=warning/info, No=default)
Contact & Intelligence section displays: associated contact name (linked if contactId present), on-site contact (name, phone, email), checkInProcedures, notes
Edit button opens PlaceFormDialog from FE-001 in edit mode, pre-populated with current place data; on save, refreshes detail view
Recent Loads section shows EmptyState from @mocho/ui with message 'No loads yet — loads referencing this facility will appear here' (placeholder until load-management)
Loading state shows FormSkeleton from @mocho/ui while fetching
All styling uses MUI sx prop
validationCommand: npm run lint --workspace=hussle-app-dispatch-ui && npm run check-ts --workspace=hussle-app-dispatch-ui && npm run test --workspace=hussle-app-dispatch-ui
